description: Hi, I am , an AI product builder blending psychology, HR, and information science. I've built Nurture AI, a postpartum support agent; SafeSpace Copilot, an Agents League-badged HR agent; and a co-op space game. I'm making a Mars outpost game where students balance life support, radiation, power, and food. Looking for a front-end/game developer, a UI designer, a space-science fact-checker, and an educator/writer. Join me!
